attempted_claim: Let P(Z^3) be lattice polytopes in R^3 and H_(2,1) the hook mixed-symmetry Schur summand of (R^3)^{tensor 3} for partition (2,1) under a fixed Young symmetrizer. Consider maps Z:P(Z^3)->H_(2,1) that are valuations, SL(3,Z)-equivariant for the induced tensor action, and translation-covariant in the McMullen--Ludwig--Silverstein sense. Via McMullen homogeneous decomposition and Ehrhart-tensor polarization, decide the exact classification formula for this irreducible summand: prove that every such Z is a unique real linear combination of explicitly named hook-projected Ehrhart-type tensors with stated basis and dimension (the zero-basis outcome allowed as a claimed classification), or disprove it by exhibiting a rigorously verified nonzero valuation of this hook type. A complete answer is a full proof of the stated hook basis/dimension formula or a verified hook-valued valuation outside that span with valuation, equivariance, covariance, and linear-independence proofs.
decisive_failure: The exact stabilizer-intertwiner computations use finite generating subsets and bounded matrix enumerations for direction stabilizers, so they rigorously establish the stated fixed-space zeros and intertwiner dimensions but do not replace the full infinite-stabilizer and Betke-Kneser dissection analysis needed to close the target classification; the symmetric-kernel vanishing observation is elementary and not a classification result.
